scope: Every source the site credits, cites or uses, built from sources.json, SOURCES.md, NOTICE.md, site-source-audit.json, site-source-sweep.json, public/content/sources/directory.json, public/content/reading-sources.json, the question bank, the acquisition reports and the sermons campaign's TERMS records. sendingRule: The owner's Gmail sends roughly 500 messages a day and bulk near-identical mail risks the account: any eventual sending goes out in small batches over days, not at once.

do-not-write.name: Scripture Buzzer question set (AyandaNgubane/Bible-Quiz)
do-not-write.terms: No licence at all, so by default all rights stay with the author. Published under the owner's rule of 2026-10-17 that unlicensed public content may be used, credited, on this non-commercial site.
do-not-write.reason: A private individual's repository: there is no organisational contact, and the brief allows organisational contacts only. A request that is refused would turn an unlicensed-but-tolerated use into a known, written refusal. The honest alternative to asking is removing the 787 questions; that is the owner's risk call, already made on 2026-10-17, and it is flagged here, not reopened.
do-not-write.problem: Its live credit reads "No licence states terms. Credit AyandaNgubane/Bible-Quiz if permission is ever obtained." That tells readers we have no permission. Whatever the owner decides, replace it with a plain credit ("Questions from AyandaNgubane/Bible-Quiz on GitHub") or remove the collection.
